segments.title: 第39章 開學報到
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 39: School Registration Day

After a summer of dormancy, the gates of Affiliated High School Number One were bustling once again.

The new first-year high school students, along with their parents who had come to see them off for registration, gathered at the school gates.

Li Luo's group of five arrived at the school gates.

Because Ying Chanxi was wearing a school uniform, she could take Ying Zhicheng straight inside.

Li Luo, on the other hand, took out his admission notice and handed it to the security guard at the gate for inspection, after which his family of three was allowed to enter.

Walking through the school gates, they were greeted by a small plaza with a giant sculpture of the school's crest in the center, surrounded by a pool of water.

After passing the water-circled sculpture was the first-year academic building.

At this moment, a crowd of students and parents was crammed in front of the notice board by the building's entrance, looking for which class their child had been assigned to.

Li Luo glanced at the formation ahead, took a deep breath, and then squeezed his way in.

But unlike others, he didn't have to search name by name. Once he squeezed to the front, a quick scan with his eyes was all it took before he backed out.

"You found it?" Ying Chanxi was momentarily stunned to see him go in and out so quickly. "How were you so fast?"

"Just lucky, I saw it right away." An image of the entire class assignment list on the notice board surfaced in Li Luo's mind. He then said, "I'm in Class Eight. Seems like there are quite a few familiar faces."

As he was saying this, a familiar voice suddenly came from the side.

"Chanxi? You're here."

Hearing someone call her name, Ying Chanxi turned her head and saw Jin Yuting waving happily at her as she trotted over.

"Tingting?" Ying Chanxi looked at her in surprise. "You made the cut?"

The cutoff score for Affiliated High School Number One this year was 510. Jin Yuting had only scored 508. Logically, she should have failed, so it was unexpected to see her at the school's registration.

"Uh… about that." Jin Yuting lowered her head, a little embarrassed, and leaned in to whisper in Ying Chanxi's ear, "My dad paid a school selection fee for me. It wasn't easy to get in."

The school selection fee for Affiliated High School Number One wasn't particularly high, but there were requirements for students who wanted to pay it. Not only did their score have to be within three points of the cutoff, but they also needed to have an advantage in a certain subject.

For example, Jin Yuting had won first prize in an English competition in middle school, which was why she barely qualified to pay the school selection fee. Otherwise, she wouldn't have had the option even if she wanted to pay.

"So that's how it is." Ying Chanxi was surprised for a moment, then smiled and nodded. "Congratulations. This way, we'll still be classmates."

"Mhm." Jin Yuting nodded happily. With the start of school, she felt an inexplicable sense of nervousness and excitement. "I wonder which class I'll be in."

"You're in Class Eight," Li Luo said from the side. "I saw your name."

"Ah? Is that so?" Jin Yuting didn't expect Li Luo to talk to her. She subconsciously avoided his gaze, her former fiery spirit from before the high school entrance exams gone. Even her voice was much softer when speaking to him.

"Yeah." Li Luo didn't mind their previous friction and nodded. "Shao Heqi and Xu Yinghuan too. The four of us are all in Class Eight."

"Really?" Ying Chanxi blinked, a hint of envy appearing. She pursed her lips, the feeling of regret growing stronger.

Why did Affiliated High School Number One have a policy like independent admissions?

It was so annoying.

"I wonder what floor Class Eight is on." Li Luo stood at the foot of the stairs and looked up.

"Four classes per floor. Just count down from the fourth floor," Ying Chanxi said from the side. "Our Class One is on the fourth floor, so your Class Eight is on the third floor. The fifth floor is the teachers' offices, and the sixth floor has various activity rooms."

"Activity rooms?"

"They're just classrooms for some of the school clubs to use temporarily," Ying Chanxi said.

"Damn, high schools have things like clubs?" Li Luo was surprised, thinking that the ordinary high school he attended in his past life didn't seem to have such a thing.

"They do." Ying Chanxi thought for a moment. "As far as I know, there's a literature club, astronomy club, painting club, basketball club, table tennis club, and I heard there's even a band in the school."

"So many clubs. They're not all just for show, are they?" Li Luo asked abruptly.

"That I don't know." Ying Chanxi shook her head. "We can just join one and see, right? Which club are you interested in?"

"I'm quite skilled at playing video games. Is there an esports club at the school?"

Ying Chanxi rolled her eyes at him. "You wish."

"Let's not dawdle, let's go upstairs." Lin Xiuhong, who had just finished greeting and chatting with Jin Yuting's parents, had joined them. Learning that their children were middle school classmates and now in the same high school class, they had spoken very politely to each other.

After their chat, they all started up the stairs, heading toward their respective classrooms.

Ying Chanxi and Ying Zhicheng said goodbye to them at the landing on the third floor and continued up to Class One on the fourth floor.

Li Luo, meanwhile, led his parents to the Class Eight classroom on the third floor.

Just as they were about to enter the classroom, however, Lin Xiuhong suddenly grabbed Li Luo's hand, pulled him aside with a smile on her face, and mysteriously stuffed a small box into his arms.

"What's this?" Li Luo looked at the tightly wrapped box in his hand and couldn't help but ask strangely.

"Just take it. It's your back-to-school gift." Lin Xiuhong instructed, "Remember not to use it carelessly. Know your limits. Studying comes first."

What do you mean, don't use it carelessly and know your limits?

Li Luo looked down at the box, thinking to himself, is my own mother this open-minded?

Could it be a Fleshlight?

Lin Xiuhong didn't give him much chance to think. After placing the gift in his hands, she led him into the Class Eight classroom.

Kong Junxiang had just finished registering Jin Yuting in front of them. When he looked up again, he saw a rather familiar figure and couldn't help but let the corners of his mouth curl up.

Seeing the smile on Kong Junxiang's face, Li Luo also smiled helplessly. He walked forward and said politely, "Hello, Teacher Kong. I'm here to register."

"It seems we're quite fated." Kong Junxiang smiled, took the admission notice and school fees from Li Luo's hand, and pointed at the student roster. "Sign here."

"Teacher, you know our Li Luo?" Lin Xiuhong asked curiously.

"During the summer break, he came to school to play basketball with a student from the advanced class. We met then." Kong Junxiang said with a cheerful laugh, "Your son is quite an interesting kid. I like him a lot."

"So that's how it is." Lin Xiuhong breathed a small sigh of relief, thinking that at least it wasn't news of Li Luo causing trouble. She quickly added, "Then we'll have to trouble Teacher Kong to look after him in the future."

"Mhm, don't you worry, Li Luo's mom," Kong Junxiang said with a gentle smile.

"Well, we've brought our son here, so we'll be going now. Goodbye, Teacher." After exchanging a few pleasantries with the teacher, Lin Xiuhong took her leave.

Kong Junxiang nodded as well and pointed to the staircase on the other side of the academic building. "You can go down that staircase. It won't be as crowded, and you can enjoy the school scenery on your way."

After seeing the parents off, Kong Junxiang looked at Li Luo with a grin. "I saw you play basketball pretty well. Want to be the sports representative?"

Hearing this, Li Luo chuckled twice. "Teacher Kong, you're underestimating me a little. I think the position of class president suits me quite well."

Before Kong Junxiang could say anything in response to his words, Li Luo heard a soft scoff from below the podium.

He turned his head and saw a familiar figure.

Shao Heqi, sitting in the front row, noticed Li Luo's gaze, immediately lowered his head, and pretended that nothing had happened.

And just as Kong Junxiang was about to speak, a tall and beautiful figure suddenly strode into the classroom from outside.

In an instant, she captured the attention of the entire class.

"Teacher," a cool voice rang out beside Li Luo's ear, "I'm Yan Zhusheng. Is this where I register?"
